record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. Derived views are whole-project files (plan.md is 85 KB), so opening one buries the phase; the tab's own text is what the reader was looking at.

## Counter-argument

Derived views are the store's published documents, already rendered and linkable, and reusing them adds no second rendering path.

payload.alternatives: open the matching derived view file at the phase heading; both, on o and O
payload.choice: o writes the current tab's full text to a temp file outside the store and opens it in glow, else $PAGER, else less

record.subject: pager-temp-file
